cohort: 7086 women who delivered a singleton live birth through IVF between December 2006 and December 2017, categorized by endometriosis diagnosis and preconception BMI.
finding: Underweight women with endometriosis conceiving via IVF had a significantly higher rate of preterm birth compared to controls without endometriosis, a finding not observed in normal weight or overweight/obese women with endometriosis.
